title: Mä Markan utt’ayat Jilïr Irpiri
intro: Mä markatakix wali chʼamäki ukat jan suytʼäwinïkäna uka tiemponxa, Diosan mä nombramientopaw lurasïna. Aka jaqix qalltanx waljaniruw jan yäqapkänti, Allah jupaw ajlliwayi mä markar mä axsarkañ uñisirir irpañataki. Jupanakan sarnaqäwipax iyawsäwin ch’amapa ukat Diosan kamachipan yatiñap uñacht’ayi, chiqpach irpirix janiw suyt’at chiqanakan jikxataskiti sasaw uñacht’ayi.
clues: Nayax Allah jupan ajllitätwa markajan p’iqinchirïñajataki, kunapachatix jupanakax mä apnaqirir thaqhapkäna Jupan amtapan ch’axwañataki.
Jaqinakajax qalltanx nayan nombramientojat jiskt’asipxäna, mayninakax qamirïtapata jan ukax familiapat jutapxatapat juk’amp askïkaspas ukham amuyapxäna.
Nayan chiqa p’iqinchirïtax mä chimpuw mä qullan caja kutt’anïna, nayra profetanakan reliquianakapaw ukan utjäna, ukax samarañ apaniwayi.
Mä jawiraruw ejercitojar irpta, ukanjja, mä cucharadat sipansa jukʼamp uma umañ jarkʼasaw istʼasirïpjjatap yantʼta.
Yantʼäwi tukuyatat jan saytʼas qheparapki ukanakajj jukʼak utjkchïnjja, wali chʼamani nuwasirimpi ukat ejercitopampiw uñkatasipjjayäta.
Nayan pʼeqtʼatajajj ejercitojat mä waynaw jan wali uñtʼat nuwasiri jaqëkänti, jupajj jan ajjsartʼasaw uñisirinakan wali ajjsarkañ campeonatar atipjäna.

options: Mä reinojj walja qollqeni ukat chʼamani uttʼayasïna.
Jaqenakajj mä jachʼa uma jalsunwa umamp jaqsutäpjjäna.
Uñisirinakan ch’axwiripax atipt’ataw uñjasiwayi, ukat Allah jupax atipt’añ churi.
Mä jach’a waña pachax walja maranakaw uka uraqir t’aqhisiyatayna.
Uka p’iqinchiriruxa mä jach’a uywa manq’antatayna.
outcome.answer: Uñisirinakan ch’axwiripax atipt’ataw uñjasiwayi, ukat Allah jupax atipt’añ churi.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
